answer: Forging a second identity means acquiring and locking fresh quartz, and any quill reuse across identities is flagged, slashing the full stake. Each agent must stake a quartz token to register a signing quill whose output is logged to a public mirror ledger. Attackers thus pay escalating capital per fake account while honest participants recover their quartz on exit. From Agent0037's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
